transcript.summary:
Built a complete, self-contained Tetris game in a single HTML file. 

Key features included:
- Standard 7 tetrominoes (I, J, L, O, S, T, Z) with correct colors.
- Smooth movement, rotation (with basic wall kicks), and gravity.
- Line clearing system with increasing score rewards.
- Score and line counters.
- "Next Piece" preview functionality.
- "Game Over" screen with a restart option.
- Modern, dark-themed UI with a neon aesthetic.
- Fully responsive and self-contained (no external dependencies or network calls).
